label: 2026-08-10 scaffold corpus, default config, FakeEmbedder
note: SCAFFOLD BASELINE — these are not quality numbers. The corpus is synthetic (see corpus.jsonl) and the embedder is FakeEmbedder, a character hash with no semantics. What this baseline gates is REGRESSION: a change that drops any figure below it altered retrieval, and that is worth knowing regardless of whether the absolute value means anything. Replace the fixtures with a redacted real export and regenerate before reading a score as quality. correctly_empty_rate is 0.0 and that is a finding, not an oversight: the vector-fallback branch admits anything above 0.05 cosine, so once rows carry embeddings, a query with no lexical match still returns whatever clears that floor. MemoryStoreQueryTest's 'returns empty' cases pass only because their rows have no embedding at all, which is not true of anything stored through MemoryStore.store. Do not raise this figure by loosening the metric.
